capabilities: Browse a built-in catalog of 15 topics, 94 patterns, and 413 problems
Time practice attempts and record four outcome types
Schedule per problem-pattern review intervals for new and repeated problems
Import and merge problems from CSV, TSV, or JSON previews
Write solution notes in Markdown and back up progress as JSON in the vault
disambiguation: Not a reference collection of algorithm notes; it is a practice trainer that times attempts and schedules reviews.
extras: README is in Russian; full setup and usage instructions are in a separate INSTALL.md. Ships a prebuilt dist folder to copy into .obsidian/plugins/. Uses a fixed interval ladder rather than FSRS, and has no automatic LeetCode sync, code running, or daily limits. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to practice coding interview problems, log attempt outcomes, or schedule their review over time.
summary: Algorithm problem trainer with a topic-pattern-problem catalog, attempt timer, manual LeetCode result entry, and spaced-repetition review queue.
